lessons.rule: Hypothesis (3 cases, does not change calls): up calls whose catalyst is an already-published or secondary-source company event, made into a falling market, have lost money.
lessons.evidence: IFX.DE long stopped out -9.88% (record quarter, guidance); shadow BP.L up 5d -0.18% wrong; shadow STMPA.PA up 5d -2.38% wrong. Shadow GSK.L up 5d -3.08% wrong is related but had a primary litigation catalyst, so it is not counted.
